topics.title: Comprehension
topics.objective: Read unseen passages closely and answer literal, inferential and vocabulary-in-context questions on them.

topics.title: Essay writing
topics.objective: Plan and compose narrative, descriptive, expository and argumentative essays with correct register and organisation.

topics.title: Summary writing
topics.objective: Identify the required points in a passage and condense them into concise grammatical sentences in the candidate's own words.

topics.title: Summary Writing
topics.objective: Identify main points and condense passages into concise sentences in the candidate's own words.

topics.title: Essay Writing
topics.objective: Plan and compose narrative, descriptive, expository and argumentative essays.

topics.title: Letter and Report Writing
topics.objective: Apply the formats and registers of formal and informal letters, speeches, articles and reports.

topics.title: Lexis and Structure
topics.objective: Apply vocabulary knowledge — synonyms, antonyms and phrasal verbs — to sentence completion items.

topics.title: Grammar and Usage
topics.objective: Apply the rules of concord, tense, voice and sentence transformation.

topics.title: Oral English
topics.objective: Identify syllables, word stress and intonation patterns tested in the Test of Orals.

topics.title: Literary Devices
topics.objective: Identify and interpret figurative language such as simile, metaphor, personification and hyperbole.
